units.en: He had no son, and many uncles and brothers still lived; Zhangzong would raise none of them, wishing only to make Prince Wei heir—so when Prince Wei tried to leave, he was kept back.
units.literal: With no heir of his own and many uncles and brothers still living, Zhangzong would establish none of them; he only wished to make Prince Wei his successor, and therefore detained him when he sought to leave.

units.zh: 而永蹈無後，乃以衛王子按陳為鄭王後，賜衛王詔曰：「朕念鄭王自棄天常，以幹國憲，槁瘞曠野，忽諸不祀。
units.en: Yongtao left no heir, so Prince Wei's son An Chen was made heir to Prince of Zheng. The edict to Prince Wei ran: "I think of Prince of Zheng, who threw away Heaven's law and breached the state's statutes, left to wither in the wild, and passed from sacrifice altogether.
units.literal: Yongtao had no heir, so the Prince of Wei's son An Chen was made successor to Prince of Zheng. An edict to Prince Wei said: "I reflect on Prince of Zheng, who abandoned Heaven's constants and violated state law, withered in burial on the open plain, gone suddenly without sacrifice.

units.zh: 歷歲既久，深用愴然。
units.en: Years have gone by, and grief weighs on me.
units.literal: Years have passed and I am deeply grieved.

units.zh: 親親之情。
units.en: Kinship tugs at the heart.
units.literal: The bonds of kin weigh upon me.

units.zh: 有懷難置。
units.en: I cannot set the feeling aside.
units.literal: My heart cannot find rest.

units.zh: 已詔追復舊爵，改葬如儀。
units.en: I have already ordered his old rank restored and a proper reburial.
units.literal: I have already ordered his former title restored and burial redone according to rite.

units.zh: 稽考古禮，以卿之子按陳為鄭王後，謹其祭祀，卿其悉之。」
units.en: By the ancient rites, your son An Chen is made heir to Prince of Zheng to keep his sacrifices—take full heed of this."
units.literal: Examining ancient rites, I make your son An Chen successor to Prince of Zheng to tend his sacrifices—see that you know this fully."

units.zh: 初，章宗誅鄭王永蹈、趙王永中，久，頗悔之。
units.en: At first Zhangzong had put Prince of Zheng Yongtao and Prince of Zhao Yongzhong to death; in time he came to regret it deeply.
units.literal: Initially Zhangzong had executed Prince of Zheng Yongtao and Prince of Zhao Yongzhong; after a long while he deeply regretted it.

units.zh: 是時，章宗已感嗽疾，衛王且辭行，而章宗意留之。
units.en: By then Zhangzong had fallen ill with a cough; Prince Wei was ready to depart, but Zhangzong meant to keep him at court.
units.literal: By then Zhangzong had contracted a coughing illness; Prince Wei was about to take leave, but Zhangzong intended to keep him.

units.zh: 宗章初年，雅愛諸王，置王傳府尉官以傳導德義。
units.en: Early in Zhangzong's reign he had loved his brothers dearly and set tutors and household officers in each prince's house to teach virtue.
units.literal: At the beginning of Zhangzong's reign he had dearly loved the princes and appointed tutors and household officers in each princely establishment to convey moral teaching.

units.zh: 而衛王乃永蹈母弟，柔弱鮮智能，故章宗愛之。
units.en: Prince Wei was Yongtao's uterine younger brother—soft, ungifted, and mild—so Zhangzong held him dear.
units.literal: Prince Wei was Yongtao's younger brother by the same mother—gentle, weak, and little gifted—so Zhangzong favored him.

units.zh: 無何，章宗大漸，元妃李氏、黃門李新喜、平章政事完顏匡定策。
units.en: Soon Zhangzong was near death; Yuan Consort Li, palace attendant Li Xinxhi, and Grand Councilor Wanyan Kuang fixed the succession.
units.literal: Before long Zhangzong fell critically ill; Yuan Consort Li, Palace Attendant Li Xinxhi, and Grand Councilor Wanyan Kuang settled the plan.

units.zh: 壬辰，章宗內人范氏損其遣腹，以詔內外。
units.en: On renchen Zhangzong's inner woman Fan injured the child she bore for him; an edict told the court and the realm.
units.literal: On renchen Zhangzong's inner attendant Fan harmed the pregnancy she was carrying for him; an edict announced this within and without.

units.zh: 初，章宗遣詔：「內人有娠者兩人，生男則立為儲貳。」
units.en: Earlier Zhangzong had sent an edict: "Two inner women are with child; whichever bears a son shall be made heir."
units.literal: Initially Zhangzong had issued an edict: "Among inner women, two are pregnant; if a son is born he shall be made heir."

units.zh: 四月庚辰，殺章宗元妃李氏及承御賈氏。
units.en: In the fourth month, on gengchen, Zhangzong’s Primary Consort Li shi and Palace Woman Jia shi were put to death.
units.literal: Fourth month, on gengchen, Zhangzong’s Primary Consort Li shi and Palace Woman Jia shi were killed.

units.zh: 《章宗實錄》詳其前事，《宜宗實錄》詳其後事。
units.en: The Veritable Record of Zhangzong treats the earlier reign; the Veritable Record of Xuanzong treats what followed.
units.literal: The Veritable Record of Zhangzong details earlier matters; the Veritable Record of Xuanzong details later matters.

units.zh: 弟倚平章政事，侃殿前都點檢，其党孛朮魯哥御史中丞，韓鐸副元帥兼知開封府，折希顏、藥安國、張軍奴、完顏合答並元帥，師肅左右司郎中，賈良兵部郎中兼右司都事，又署工部尚書溫蒂罕二十、吏部侍郎劉仲周並為參知政事，宣徽使奧屯舜卿為尚書左丞，戶部侍郎張正倫為尚書右丞，左右司都事張節為左右司郎中，尚書省掾元好問為左右司員外郎，都轉運知事王天祺、懷州同知康瑭並為左右司都事。
units.en: His brother Yi became equal-rank minister; Kan became palace front commandant; Bolüluoge, his partisan, vice censor-in-chief; Han Duo vice marshal and Kaifeng prefect; Zhe Xiyan, Yao Anguo, Zhang Junnu, and Wanyan Heda marshals; Shi Su a department director; Jia Liang military affairs director and right department chief; Wendihan Ershi minister of works and Liu Zhongzhou vice minister of personnel participation councillors; Aotun Shunqing left vice minister; Zhang Zhenglun right vice minister; Zhang Jie department director; Yuan Haowen, a ministry clerk, deputy director; Wang Tianqi and Huaizhou vice prefect Kang Tang department chiefs.
units.literal: His younger brother Yi was Equal-Rank Minister; Kan was Palace Front Commandant; his clique member Bolüluoge was Vice Censor-in-Chief; Han Duo was Vice Marshal and concurrent Kaifeng prefect; Zhe Xiyan, Yao Anguo, Zhang Junnu, and Wanyan Heda were all marshals; Shi Su was a Left and Right Department director; Jia Liang was Bureau of Military Affairs director and concurrent Right Department chief; he also appointed Minister of Works Wendihan Ershi and Vice Minister of Personnel Liu Zhongzhou as participation councillors; Palace Intendant Aotun Shunqing as Left Vice Minister, Revenue Vice Minister Zhang Zhenglun as Right Vice Minister; Department chief Zhang Jie as director; archival clerk Yuan Haowen as deputy director; and transport officials Wang Tianqi and Huaizhou vice prefect Kang Tang as department chiefs.

units.zh: 列侯三年，聶政殺韓相俠累。
units.en: In the third year of Marquis Lie, the assassin Nie Zheng killed the Han chancellor Xia Lei.
units.literal: In Lie Hou's third year, Nie Zheng killed the Han chancellor Xia Lei.

units.zh: 韓厥，晉景公之三年，晉司寇屠岸賈將作亂，誅靈公之賊趙盾。
units.en: In the third year of Duke Jing of Jin, the Minister of Justice Tu'an Jia plotted to carry out a purge, intending to punish Zhao Dun for the assassination of Duke Ling.
units.literal: Han Jue, in Jin Jing Gong's third year, the Jin Si Kou Tu An Jia was about to rebel and execute Ling Gong's traitor Zhao Dun.

units.zh: 靖康元年，以給事中使斡離不軍，議割三鎮以和。
units.en: In Jingkang 1 he was sent as supervising secretary to Wolibu's camp to negotiate ceding the three prefectures in exchange for peace.
units.literal: In the first year of Jingkang he was sent as supervising secretary to Wolibu's army to negotiate ceding the three prefectures for peace.

units.zh: 使還，傳道斡離不之意，以為黏罕得朝廷所與餘睹蠟書，堅雲中國不可信，欲敗和約。
units.en: On his return he reported Wolibu's message: Nianhan had obtained a wax-sealed letter from the court to Yelü Yudu and insisted that the Song could not be trusted, intending to break the peace treaty.
units.literal: On his return he relayed Wolibu's meaning, saying that Nianhan had obtained from the court a wax-sealed letter to Yelü Yudu, and firmly declared the Central States untrustworthy, wishing to break the peace treaty.

units.zh: 監察御史陶鈞以攜妓游北苑，歌飲池島間，迫近殿廷，提控官石玠聞而發之。
units.en: Investigating Censor Tao Jun was found to have escorted courtesans through the Northern Park, singing and drinking among its ponds and islets in proximity to the palace halls; Surveillance Officer Shi Jie heard of it and reported the affair.
units.literal: Investigating censor Tao Jun, taking courtesans to roam the Northern Park, singing and drinking among ponds and islets, approaching near the palace precincts—surveillance officer Shi Jie heard and exposed it.

units.zh: 鈞令其友閻恕 屬玠得緩。
units.en: Tao Jun had his friend Yan Shu intercede with Shi Jie to secure lenient handling.
units.literal: Jun had his friend Yan Shu ask Shi Jie to obtain leniency.

units.zh: 詔以鈞耳目之官，攜妓入禁苑，無上下之分，杖六十，玠、恕皆坐之。
units.en: An edict ruled that Tao Jun, as an imperial censor, had violated the distinction of rank by bringing courtesans into the forbidden park and sentenced him to sixty strokes of the staff; Shi Jie and Yan Shu were also convicted.
units.literal: An edict held that Jun, as an organ of the ruler's senses, bringing courtesans into the forbidden park, showed no distinction of superior and subordinate—sixty strokes of the staff; Shi and Yan were both convicted as well.

units.zh: 昔燕太子使荆轲劫始皇，变起两楹之间，其后谒者持匕首刺腋，高祖偃武行文，故易之以板。」
units.en: Formerly the crown prince of Yan sent Jing Ke to seize the First Emperor; the crisis arose between the two pillars, and afterward receptionists carried daggers at the armpit. Gaozu laid aside arms and promoted culture, and therefore replaced them with tablets."
units.literal: Formerly the crown prince of Yan sent Jing Ke to seize the First Emperor; the crisis arose between the two pillars, and afterward a receptionist stabbed him in the armpit with a dagger. Emperor Gaozu laid aside arms and promoted culture, and therefore replaced daggers with tablets."

units.zh: 對捍使者尚得死坐，況遊道吐不臣之言，犯慢上之罪，口稱夷、齊，心懷盜跖，欺公賣法，受納苞苴，產隨官厚，財與位積，雖贓汚未露，而姦詐如是。
units.en: Resisting an envoy earns death; how much more unministered words, slighting superiors, mouth naming Yi and Qi while heart harbors robbers, deceiving the public, taking bribes—wealth piled with rank though bribery was not yet exposed.
units.literal: Resisting an envoy still earns death; how much more Youdao's unministered words, the crime of slighting superiors, mouth naming Yi and Qi while heart harboring robbers, deceiving the public and selling the law, receiving wrapped bribes—property following office thick, wealth with rank piled; though bribery was not yet exposed, treachery was such.
